question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'hub.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence "***‘Make in India’ is a call to the global manufacturers aimed at making India a manufacturing ___(2)___***'' is indicating **to make something in large quantities using machines in India**.
 
• The use of the word ''manufacturing'' in the sentence indicates **the making of articles on a large scale using machinery; industrial production**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'hub'.
